clue.text: Getting impassioned with a politician can be dangerous!

definitions.text: Getting impassioned with a politician can be dangerous!

parts.note: getting fired up, roused to passion, is being fired
MP, Member of Parliament, is the standard politician

explanation.surface: A warning that a politician who gets too worked up is a hazard.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as the definition: firedamp is the explosive methane gas of coal mines, which is literally dangerous when it gets fired.
explanation.definitionFit: Firedamp is methane in coal mines, a gas that explodes when ignited, so igniting it is perilous.

clue.text: Continue, to signal for a bottle

indicators.note: to here means the first piece is attached to the second, which follows it

parts.note: a flag is used to signal
to carry on is to go on, so continue means on

explanation.surface: Someone is told to keep signalling for another bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: A flagon is a large bottle or jug for wine or cider.

clue.text: Wheel of gold returned to art gallery

indicators.note: returned means the gold's letters come back the other way

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
the Tate is the famous London art gallery

explanation.surface: A golden wheel is brought back to an art gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tate is a group of major British art galleries in London and elsewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: To wheel is to turn or spin round, as a squadron wheels.

clue.text: A complaint possibly sees aid given.

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters of sees aid may be arranged differently

explanation.surface: A grievance perhaps sees help offered.
explanation.definitionFit: A complaint is an illness or ailment, as in a chest complaint.

clue.text: Many an ancient vessel makes an impression

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so many
Noah's Ark is the ancient vessel

explanation.surface: Many an old ship leaves an impression.
explanation.definitionFit: A mark is a trace or impression left on a surface.

clue.text: Arranges music for records

explanation.surface: Someone orchestrates tunes for a recording session.
explanation.definitionFit: To score a piece is to arrange it for instruments, and scores are also tallies or records of points.

clue.text: The brave guy confined to bed will get a cigar

indicators.note: the brave guy is held inside the bed, confined there

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
a hero is a brave man

explanation.surface: A bedridden hero gets a cigar as consolation.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheroot is a cigar cut square at both ends.

clue.text: He'll prove to be wrong about farm produce

parts.note: re means about or concerning
butter is produced on dairy farms

explanation.surface: Someone will show they are mistaken about produce from the farm.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as a person who demonstrates another to be wrong, taking 'He'll prove' as that person's job.
explanation.definitionFit: One who refutes an argument by showing it false is one who rebuts.

clue.text: The new purser is a wonder!

indicators.note: new means purser is is given a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: The newly appointed ship's purser is a marvel.
explanation.definitionFit: A surprise is something astonishing, a marvel.

clue.text: To create a stir, try imaginative workmanship

indicators.note: creating something from a stir means making new letters out of those words

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Advice to make a splash by attempting inventive handiwork.
explanation.definitionFit: Artistry is creative skill, the craftsmanship of an artist.

clue.text: From September berries form the main food of a North African

indicators.note: the letters are taken out of the run of the two words that follow

explanation.surface: A claim that late-summer berries are the staple diet of someone from North Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: The run spans the end of 'September' and the start of 'berries'; 'form the main food of' just completes the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: The Berbers are an indigenous people of North Africa, so one of them is a native of that region.

clue.text: Practical approach when one's entering a country

indicators.note: one's goes inside the country, entering it

parts.note: a realm is a kingdom or country
one is I, so one's is I plus S

explanation.surface: A pragmatic attitude is needed when someone arrives in a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Realism is the practical outlook that accepts things as they are.

clue.text: Not in position for spending

parts.note: someone not in is out
the lay of the land is its position or arrangement

explanation.surface: A comment that a job placement is outside one's spending range.
explanation.definitionFit: An outlay is money laid out, an expenditure.

clue.text: Gun-dog carrying a duck or other aquatic creature

indicators.note: the gun-dog holds the other pieces within it, as if carrying them

parts.note: a setter is a breed of gun-dog used in shooting
a duck is a zero score in cricket, the shape of O

explanation.surface: A retriever brings back a shot duck or some other water animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Sea otters are marine mammals of the Pacific that live almost entirely in water.

clue.text: Provided for a fellow leftist

parts.note: cove is old British slang for a chap or fellow
a red is a left-winger or communist

explanation.surface: Someone supplied a left-wing chap with what he needed.
explanation.definitionFit: If costs are covered, they are paid or provided for.

clue.text: Erudite people, writers!

explanation.surface: A tribute to scholarly authors.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes learned scholars, and literally also those who write letters, that is correspondents or authors.

clue.text: To keep a check on careless talk?

definitions.text: To keep a check on careless talk?

parts.words: To keep a check on careless talk?
parts.note: careless talk is idle chatter or gas, and a device that checks it measures that gas

explanation.definitionFit: A gas meter records how much domestic gas is used, playing on gas as empty chatter.

clue.text: Boards setting a proposal before most important man

indicators.note: the proposal is set before the important man
the proposal is set before the important man

parts.note: a plan is a proposal
a king is the most important man in a kingdom

explanation.surface: A scheme laid before the top man.
explanation.definitionFit: Planking is boards or planks collectively, as on a ship's deck.

clue.text: Noted all past blunders in one's lifetime

indicators.note: blunders suggests the noted words go wrong and are muddled into new order

explanation.surface: Someone records every past mistake made over the years.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase comes from the Bible's 'threescore years and ten', the span of life allotted to a person.
explanation.definitionFit: The allotted span is the traditional seventy years a person is given to live.

clue.text: Double-dealer offering characteristic alternative

parts.note: a trait is a characteristic
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A two-faced person offers a typical alternative.
explanation.definitionFit: A traitor betrays trust, a classic two-faced dealer.

clue.text: Written notice-a bad bloomer

indicators.note: bad means notice a is spoilt into a new order

explanation.surface: A written notice proves a bad blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' looks like a mistake; here it is a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Aconite, or monkshood, is a flowering plant, and a bloomer is something that flowers.

clue.text: A prisoner gets taken in by a well-qualified person in Spain

indicators.note: the prisoner is taken into the graduate's letters

parts.note: an MA, Master of Arts, is a well-qualified graduate
lag is slang for a convict

explanation.surface: A convict is taken in by a qualified professional.
explanation.definitionFit: Malaga is a port city in Andalusia, so a place found in Spain.

clue.text: Look over an article and feel furious

indicators.note: in a down answer, over places the first piece above the second

parts.note: to see is to look
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Someone reads through an article and gets angry.
explanation.definitionFit: To seethe is to boil with anger.

clue.text: Ships' officers going round and obtaining orders

indicators.note: the officers surround the next word, going round it

parts.note: mates are officers on merchant ships
taken as written

explanation.surface: Ship's officers make their rounds and pick up their instructions.
explanation.definitionFit: Mandates are official commands or authorisations to act.

clue.text: The baboon has the same open-mouthed stare

parts.note: do, short for ditto, means the same as above
to gape is to stare with the mouth open

explanation.surface: A baboon stares back gormlessly, just like the onlooker.
explanation.definitionFit: Dog-ape is an old name for the baboon, from its dog-like muzzle.

clue.text: Affection that means nothing

explanation.surface: A cynical view of fondness.
explanation.definitionFit: Love is fondness, and in tennis scoring it is nil.

clue.text: A number wanting a drink is pointless

indicators.note: pointless means a compass point is removed from the word

parts.note: someone wanting a drink is thirsty
S, south, is one of the compass points

explanation.surface: A remark that a count of people craving a drink is futile.
explanation.definitionFit: Thirty is a cardinal number, three tens.

clue.text: Row about doctor backing social worker-ruling called for

indicators.note: the noise surrounds the doctor, placed about it

parts.note: a row is a loud noise, a din

indicators.note: backing means the doctor's letters run in reverse

parts.note: MO, medical officer, is a doctor
an ant is a social insect and a worker

explanation.surface: An argument over a doctor supporting a social worker leads to a required ruling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Social worker' suggests a welfare officer; here it is the colony-dwelling insect.
explanation.definitionFit: Dominant means controlling or prevailing, as a ruling party is.

clue.text: Consider fish when in the red

indicators.note: the fish is placed in the colour

parts.note: taken as written, minus the article
the gar is a long-snouted fish

explanation.surface: Thinking about fish when one is in debt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the red' looks like the idiom for overdrawn; it is the letters RED holding the fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To regard something is to consider or look upon it.

clue.text: Left always with time to make purchase

parts.note: ever means always, as in ever hopeful
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone left forever with time to make a shopping trip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Purchase' here means grip or mechanical advantage, not buying.
explanation.definitionFit: Purchase is a firm hold giving mechanical advantage, the same as the force gained by a lever.
